content.subject: Month-end close and manual reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,

Excited to see Jon Anderson, CFO, sharing insights in Global FinTech Series. Month-end close stalls when reconciliation requires manual matching across systems, forcing staff to chase missing entries.

We build a bot that pulls transaction data and posts matched entries to your ledger.

Can we schedule a brief call next week to explore if this fits your priorities?

Zamp
